verdict.rationale: Teller is a server-side REST API that a script or CI job can call directly. It uses mTLS client-certificate auth (teller-docs-12), and its balances and transactions endpoints are idempotent and paginated (teller-docs-2, teller-docs-20, teller-docs-21). A sandbox with simulated data and a fixed OTP code of 0000 suits automated tests (teller-docs-8, teller-docs-9), and a community user built an export script on the API (teller-comm-1). However, linking accounts goes through the interactive Teller Connect flow, and webhooks are set up in the dashboard (teller-docs-7, teller-docs-23), so not everything is headless. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/headless setup guidance, programmatic (non-UI) enrollment and webhook configuration, and independent hands-on CI corroboration.
